hook.text: Zombies took over my building. And I'm stuck on the thirteenth floor.

no3.text: Thirteen floors. Straight down. Also no.

tie.text: So I tied every bedsheet I own.

more.text: Curtains. My hoodie. One very long scarf.

math.text: My math says it reaches the tenth floor. That's fine. That's totally fine.

f11.text: Floor eleven. Don't. Look. At him.

f10.text: Floor ten. The rope ends here. Okay. Next problem.

move.text: Wait. Why is my rope... moving?

end.text: Part two. Follow, so I don't die alone.
